items.review_rationale: Reviewed right group action of G on X with map X times G to X, right-identity axiom, and multiplication order beta(beta(x,g),h)=beta(x,gh).

references.phrase: mapping beta:X times G to X

references.context: The group identity fixes every x under right action.
Successive right actions by g and h agree with action by product gh.

references.disposition: Do not replace by left-action multiplication or assume G commutative.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed bounded linear transformation between real or complex normed vector spaces over one field, with a single uniform nonnegative real bound for all domain vectors.

references.phrase: vector norms on X and Y

references.context: One finite real M at least zero bounds the norm ratio globally for every x in domain.

references.phrase: same scalar field real or complex
references.disposition: X and Y share one field F in {R,C}; this definition makes no division-ring generalization.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed supremum-of-unit-ball characterization of operator norm for bounded linear transformation between normed real/complex spaces, with finite output and closed-ball criterion.

references.phrase: norms of domain and target vectors

references.context: Subset of X containing all vectors whose norm is at most one.
Least upper bound in real numbers of the set of target norms for unit-ball inputs.

references.disposition: Because T is bounded, the supremum is a finite nonnegative real number.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed infimum-of-admissible-bounds characterization for bounded operator, with strict M>0, all x quantification, and 0 operator infimum possibility.

references.context: Positive real constant satisfying ||Tx||_Y<=M||x||_X for every x in X.
Greatest lower bound of all positive constants satisfying the global norm inequality.

references.phrase: zero operator may have infimum zero
references.disposition: Even though admissible M values are strictly positive, their infimum can equal zero.
